name: verification-and-handoff
goal: Xác minh end-to-end và chứng minh không phát sinh bài nộp/quota.

repository_conventions: Verification must use the repository's documented Flutter, Maven, and pnpm commands and preserve unrelated dirty worktree changes.
Evidence must distinguish unit/widget/fixture coverage from actual Postgres, network, and Windows release checks.
Reports belong under pte-doc/plans/reports and must record exact exits, test totals, skips, and untested boundaries.
boundaries: Do not commit, push, deploy, reset, or discard unrelated changes during handoff.
Do not claim live DB, network, or Windows proof when the required environment is unavailable.
Keep student enforcement and existing answer persistence behavior unchanged.
applicable_rules: Run tests required by Quang; report quality gate as intentionally skipped.
Validate the plan bundle after all phase and evidence updates.
allowed_exceptions: Quality gate is skipped by Quang and must remain skipped_by_user; unit/integration tests are required and owned by ck:test.

steps.description: Cập nhật README/AGENTS/IAM nếu cần theo feature thực tế; kiểm diff từng repo bảo toàn dirty changes. File manifest đủ tất cả source/test/migration đã chạm.
success_criteria: Diff review/file manifest đối chiếu mọi changed file, không unrelated user edit mất; README/AGENTS đúng role feature.

steps.description: Run app analyze/full tests, API compile/default suite/Postgres, web api-client/ui/tenant/vendor typecheck + lint/scoped tests. Dùng commands handoff §8 và actual scripts; thu exit/skips.
success_criteria: Verification report có command/exit/test totals/skips cho API/app/web; no unrun integration claim.

steps.description: Windows release smoke host READY + next đang ghi/audio + final exit + host logout/student login; kiểm layout đúng reference và enforcement không còn global flag. RG01–02.
success_criteria: Windows release evidence host preview READY thành công với flags mặc định, không student guard kích hoạt trên host.

steps.description: E2E DB/network/queue/quota deltas baseline SAU creation, TRƯỚC preview; chỉ scoped records của test identity. Cho phép auth/notification writes, cấm attempt/answer/media-upload/scoring. Handoff §8, DA01–04.
success_criteria: Session-scoped DB/network/quota trước/sau preview không thay đổi attempt/answer/upload/grading; auth/inbox writes phân biệt rõ.

steps.description: Điền toàn bộ acceptance statuses/evidence và 22 code coverage; review findings, report blockers/untested boundaries, bàn giao Quang. Không commit/push/deploy; validate plan bundle.
success_criteria: Acceptance rows có statuses/evidence, 22 canonical code coverage tách fixture/actual API/Windows; bundle validation exit 0.
